title: भाषिक परिवर्तन र नेपाली भाषा Bhashik Paribartan ra Nepali Bhasha
nepali: भाषिक परिवर्तन र नेपाली भाषा शीर्षकको यस लेखमा ऐतिहासिक विकासका सन्दर्भमा नेपाली भाषामा देखापरेकापरिवर्तित विशेषताहरूको विश्लेषण गरिएको छ । भाषा परिवर्तनशील वस्तु हो । समयक्रममा भाषाका विविधपक्षमा नयाँनयाँ प्रवृत्तिहरू देखा पर्दछन् । यस लेखमा नेपाली भाषामा यस किसिमका परिवर्तनशील विशेषताहरूकेकस्ता छन् भन्ने कुरालाई मुख्य समस्याका रूपमा लिई ती समस्याहरूको प्राज्ञिक समाधान खोज्ने प्रयास गरिएकोछ । यस अध्ययनमा भाषिक परिवर्तनसँग सम्बन्धित विद्वान् लेखकहरूका ग्रन्थहरू, अनुसन्धानमूलक लेखहरूकासाथै जनबोलीसँग सम्बन्धित तथ्यहरूलाई सामग्रीका रूपमा लिइएको छ । वर्णनात्मक तथा विवरणात्मक विधिद्वारासामग्रीको विश्लेषण गरिएको यस अध्ययनमा भाषा विकासका सन्दर्भमा नेपाली भाषाका ध्वनि व्यवस्थादेखि लिएरअर्थसम्मका तहमा भएका परिवर्तनको अवस्थालाई विश्लेषण गरिएको छ । यसैगरी यस लेखमा नेपाली इतर अन्यभाषाहरूको प्रभावका साथै स्वयम् नेपाली भाषाकै भाषिकाहरूका प्रभावका कारण नेपाली भाषाका ध्वनि, व्याकरणतथा अर्थका तहसम्म भाषिक परिवर्तन भएको सारवस्तुलाई प्रस्तुत गरिएको छ । नेपालका अन्य भाषाका तुलनामानेपाली भाषा बढी समृद्ध र गतिशील भए पनि आधुनिकीकरणका सन्दर्भमा सरलीकरण तथा कथ्यीकरणतर्फगतिशील हुन यो भाषा परिवर्तित संरचनासहित अगाडि बढिरहेको तथ्यलाई यस अध्ययनमा प्रस्तुत गरिएको छ ।परिवर्तित हुँदै अगाडि बढ्ने सन्दर्भमा यसमा सकारात्मक तथा नकारात्मक दुवै किसिमको अवस्था देखिएको हुँदानेपाली भाषाको विकासमा भाषाविद् तथा वाङ्मयका क्षेत्रमा काम गर्नेहरूले सचेत हुनुपर्ने निष्कर्षलाई यसअध्ययनमा प्रस्तुत गरिएको छ ।
american_english: In this article titled "Linguistic Change and the Nepali Language," the changed characteristics that have appeared in the Nepali language in the context of historical development are analyzed. Language is a changeable entity. Over time, brand-new tendencies appear in various aspects of language. Taking what kinds of changing characteristics exist in the Nepali language as the main problem, this article attempts to seek an academic solution to those problems. In this study, treatises of scholarly authors related to linguistic change, research articles, along with facts related to colloquial speech have been taken as material. In this study, where the material was analyzed through descriptive and expository methods, the state of changes that occurred from the phonetic system to the level of meaning of the Nepali language in the context of language development has been analyzed. Likewise, this article presents the substance of how linguistic change occurred at the levels of sound, grammar, and meaning of the Nepali language due to the influence of other languages besides Nepali as well as the influence of dialects of the Nepali language itself. Although the Nepali language is richer and more dynamic compared to other languages of Nepal, this study presents the fact that in the context of modernization, this language is moving forward with an altered structure to be dynamic toward simplification and colloquialization. Since both positive and negative conditions are seen in the context of changing and moving forward, this study presents the conclusion that linguists and those working in the field of literature must remain alert regarding the development of the Nepali language.

informal_english: In this article titled "Linguistic Change and the Nepali Language", the changed characteristics that have cropped up in the Nepali language over historical development get analysed. Language is an ever-changing thing, to be sure. Over time, brand-new trends show up in various aspects of language. Taking what kinds of changing characteristics exist in the Nepali language as the main problem, this paper tries to find an academic solution to those problems. In this study, treatises by scholarly authors on language change, research articles, along with facts about everyday colloquial speech have been taken as material. In this study, where the material was analysed through descriptive and expository methods, the state of changes that occurred from the phonetic system right up to the level of meaning in the Nepali language gets analysed. Likewise, this article presents the gist of how linguistic change occurred at the levels of sound, grammar, and meaning in the Nepali language due to the influence of other languages as well as dialects of the Nepali language itself. Although the Nepali language is richer and more dynamic compared to other languages of Nepal, this study presents the fact that with modernisation going on, this language is moving forward with an altered structure toward simplification and spoken forms. Since both positive and negative conditions are seen in the context of changing and moving forward, this study presents the conclusion that linguists and literature folk must stay alert regarding the development of the Nepali language.
